notes:
apra-fleet-tfx.6 (commit 52f513d, 5 files) is very nearly right, and both of the doer's judgment calls are CORRECT and must be preserved. It is reopened for exactly ONE mechanical defect: three orphaned bd-recording fixtures.

BLOCKING -- orphaned fixtures (the only reason for this reopen). The bead's file list named two fixtures to delete (apra-fleet-mock-sprint-serversidepridem.jsonl, apra-fleet-mock-sprint-serversideprmissing.jsonl) and both were deleted correctly. But c5e66566 added FIVE server-side-PR recordings, not two. These three remain tracked and are now dead weight (172 KB total):
  packages/apra-fleet-se/test/fixtures/bd-recordings/apra-fleet-mock-sprint-serversideprok.jsonl
  packages/apra-fleet-se/test/fixtures/bd-recordings/apra-fleet-mock-sprint-serversideprnoapp.jsonl
  packages/apra-fleet-se/test/fixtures/bd-recordings/apra-fleet-mock-sprint-serversideprnonhosted.jsonl
Proof they are orphaned: 'git log --all' shows all three were introduced by c5e66566 solely to feed server-side-pr-creation.test.mjs, whose scenarios were tagged serversideprok / serversideprnoapp / serversideprnonhosted; this commit deleted that sole consumer. An unfiltered 'grep -rni serversidepr packages/apra-fleet-se --exclude-dir=node_modules -l' matches ONLY the three fixture files themselves (their own embedded scenario tag) -- no test, helper, manifest, json or doc references them. So the orphaning is a regression introduced by this commit, against the task's own stated purpose ('Remove the test surface that pinned the reverted server-side PR path'). Nothing downstream will catch it: the umbrella's AC1 machine check filters --include=*.ts/*.mjs/*.js, so .jsonl fixtures are invisible to it, and tfx.7/8/9 do not touch test/fixtures/bd-recordings/. Fix is a three-file delete; no other edit is needed.

DO NOT REGRESS THESE -- both are correct as shipped:
1. EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT = 44 must STAY 44. The bead's AC3 literal '42' is arithmetically stale: commit 64dc595 (jfo verify-route, unrelated to this streak) added two command() call sites and bumped the constant 43 -> 45, then tfx.5 removed one site (finalizeAbort's failSoft 'git remote get-url origin' probe), giving 45 - 1 = 44. Writing 42 would break the test. The doer set 44 AND replaced the stale 6bu comment with a correct audit trail at dispatch-safety-guard.test.mjs:209-220 -- exactly the handoff correction flagged in the tfx.5 review. Verified passing: 'every command()/agent() call site in runner.js passes member_name or member_id' PASS.
2. The four 'create_pull_request' hits in packages/apra-fleet-se/test/vcs-module.test.mjs:81,92,93,166 must STAY. They are NEGATIVE guard assertions from the VCSModule bead (assert.ok(!result.command.toLowerCase().includes('create_pull_request'))) that pin the absence of the reverted path. AC2's literal 'grep returns no hits' is therefore unsatisfiable without deleting legitimate assertions belonging to another bead. Leave them alone.

WHAT IS ALREADY CORRECT: server-side-pr-creation.test.mjs (365 lines, 17 cases) is deleted and unreferenced. The harness revert is provably exact -- 'git diff c5e66566^..HEAD -- packages/apra-fleet-se/test/helpers/mock-sprint-harness.mjs' returns EMPTY output, i.e. byte-identical to its pre-6bu state, including removal of the prToolHandler option, the effectiveCallTool wrapper, and the prToolCalls return field (which has no remaining consumer). The commit touches only the five in-scope files; no temp files or unrelated edits.

GATES: npm run build (build:contract + tsc) clean, exit 0. npm run lint not configured in this repo (no lint script in root package.json) -- skipped, not a finding. Root vitest 205 files / 2891 tests passed, 36 skipped, exit 0. apra-fleet-se npm test: 1512 pass / 1 fail / 3 skipped. The single failure is golden-transcript.test.mjs, which is PRE-EXISTING and unrelated -- same divergence documented in the tfx.5 review, at dispatch seq 96 (JSONL line 97), caused purely by the integ-test-runner-output schema gaining verifySetClosed/verifySetLeftOpen from the jfo work (64dc595 / 4ea4429). Not caused by tfx.5 or tfx.6. Note this makes AC4 ('full suite green') unsatisfiable for tfx.6 through no fault of the doer -- the newTask below fixes that.

REPLAN RATIONALE (tfx.6 is in replanIds): three of its four acceptance criteria are defective as written, so a bare re-dispatch would push the next doer toward wrong edits -- AC3's literal 42 (must be 44), AC2's clean-grep requirement (would delete valid vcs-module assertions), AC4's green-suite requirement (blocked by unrelated golden-transcript drift), plus the fixture list naming 2 of the 5 files, which is what caused this finding. A planner should rewrite the criteria to: delete all five serversidepr* recordings; set EXPECTED_COMMAND_COUNT to 44; scope the grep check to exclude negative guard assertions; and scope 'suite green' to exclude the known golden-transcript drift. UMBRELLA WARNING: apra-fleet-tfx's AC7 carries the same stale 'call-site count restored to 42' and will misfire at umbrella verification unless corrected to 44 (or to whatever tfx.8 sets when it re-wires the PR path, since tfx.8 owns the next adjustment to that constant per the mutex note).

This is intentional prompt drift, not a regression, so the fixture needs regenerating: run 'npm run update-golden -w @apralabs/apra-fleet-se' (or UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 node --test test/golden-transcript.test.mjs), then review the regenerated snapshot to confirm ONLY the two schema properties change and no dispatch-sequence delta sneaks in.
